title: Hypaereon Evolved
description: Hypaereon Evolved is a Minecraft mod that adds two new forests, two Brazilian biomes , and more is coming soon. The mod is under constant development, and these initial versions are what's to come.
body:
# About hypaereon evolved

Hyperion Evolved is a Minecraft mod that adds a new Brazilian biome to Minecraft: the Amazonian Forest, and a new type of wood called Jegpeak.

A new type of wood called Patry was added, along with its variations (slabs, stairs, and others), where the Brazilian Cerrado biome was also included.

The mod will soon add more things, focusing on bringing real-life elements like biomes, plants, animals, and more. The update is a Great World Update that aims to expand upon the Minecraft world we know.

# Craftings

These are all the available crafting methods in the mod, including crafting and brewing:

1. Jegpeak Planks: 1 Jegpeak log for 4, and 1 Jegpeak wood for 2.
2. Jegpeak Wood: 1 Jegpeak log for 2.
3. Jungle Planks: heating up 1 Jegpeak planks for a Jungle planks.
4. Stick: 2 Jegpeak planks for 1.
5. Jegpeak Slabs: 3 Jegpeak Planks(in slab format) for 3.
6. Jegpeak Stairs: 3 Jegpeak Planks(in stair format) for 1.
7. Jegpeak Fence: 2 Sticks & Jegpeak Planks(in fence format) for 3.
8. Jegpeak Fence Gate: 2 Sticks & Jegpeak Planks(in fence gate format) for 3.
9. Jegpeak Door: 6 Jegpeak Planks(in door format) for 3.
10. Jegpeak Trapdoor : 6 Jegpeak Planks(in trapdoor format) for 3.
11. Patry Planks: 1 Patry log for 4, and 1 patry wood for 2.
12. Patry Wood: 1 Patry log for 2.
13. Jngle Planks(with Patry Planks): heating up 1 Patry planks for a Jungle planks.
14. Stick(with Patry Planks): 2 Patry planks for 1.
15. Patry Slabs: 3 Patry Planks(in slab format) for 3.
16. Patry Stairs: 3 Patry Planks(in stair format) for 1.
17. Patry Fence: 2 Sticks & Patry Planks(in fence format) for 3.
18. Patry Fence Gate: 2 Sticks & Patry Planks(in fence gate format) for 3.
19. Patry Door: 6 Patry Planks(in door format) for 3.
20. Patry Trapdoor : 6 Jegpeak Planks(in trapdoor format) for 3.

## observations

The Jegpeak Roots are removed in 1.0.3.25 alpha

The jaguar is not fully developed and has some errors. If you find any errors in the mod, please let me know so I can improve it.
